name: KYE PR Loop
description: The real KYE Protocol delegated-build loop encoded as workflow-as-code: a sub-agent builds on an isolated branch, npm test runs the full gate chain, a human reviews the PR (single_approver), and on pass the change merges. This replaces the manual 'dispatch sub-agent → run gates → human-gate → rebase → merge' sequence.

nodes.label: Delegated build
nodes.agent_brief: Implement the spec on an isolated worktree branch; challenge the spec and cite the canonical being extended before writing code (CLAUDE.md delegated-agent discipline).
